header: The spreadsheet did the job. It just did it slowly.
lead: Nothing here is a criticism of anyone's spreadsheet. It is a list of the things a shared file cannot do once there is more than one branch.
note: Times are the median across 34 sites in their first three months, measured against what the same sites reported before.

rows.title: Building next week
rows.text: Copy the tab, retype the changes, check the contracts by memory

rows.title: Telling the team
rows.text: A photograph in a group chat, re-sent every time something moves

rows.title: A rest-period breach
rows.text: Found in the following month, if at all

rows.title: Cost of the week
rows.text: Calculated afterwards, in a second workbook

rows.title: Month-end hours
rows.text: Retyped from clock cards into a payroll sheet

rows.title: Who changed what
rows.text: Whatever the file history happens to remember
